meta_description: Elite Decorating in Birmingham offers interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, and full decoration services. Free quotes, reliable local team.
hero_eyebrow: Local Birmingham Decorators — Quality Paint & Wallpaper
hero_subhead: From fresh walls to complete room makeovers, Elite Decorating delivers quality finishes on time and on budget across Birmingham.
services_subhead: Whether you need a quick refresh or a full room transformation, we handle everything from preparation to final touches.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Fresh walls, ceilings, and woodwork using premium paints. We prepare surfaces properly so your new finish lasts years, not months.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Expert hanging of traditional wallpaper or modern wall coverings. We match patterns precisely and handle tricky corners and architraves.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding
services.desc: Durable exterior finishes that withstand Birmingham weather. We prepare, prime, and paint doors, fascias, soffits, and rendered walls.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Hand-painted doors, skirting, dado rails, and fitted furniture. We sand, prime, and apply quality finishes to match your décor.

services.title: Textured Coatings & Specialist Finishes
services.desc: Artex removal and replacement, polished plaster, and decorative effects. Create depth and character in any room.

services.title: Commercial & Residential Contracts
services.desc: Full redecoration of offices, rental properties, and multi-room homes. We work to timescales that suit you, minimal disruption guaranteed.

about_pullquote: We take pride in finishing what others rush through — every detail matters to us.
about_para_1: Elite Decorating was established in 2009 by decorators who were tired of seeing poor preparation ruin expensive paint jobs. Over 15 years, we've built a reputation across Quinton, Harborne, and wider Birmingham for meticulous preparation, quality materials, and finishes that last. Every team member is trained in our standards — no shortcuts, no excuses.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we listen, we show up on time, and we leave their homes cleaner than when we arrived. We hold ourselves to the same standard whether you're painting one bedroom or a five-bedroom house. That's why over 80% of our work comes from recommendations and repeat clients.
reviews_heading: What Birmingham Homeowners Say About Elite Decorating

reviews.text: Had the whole of the upstairs redecorated — four bedrooms, landing, and bathroom. The lads were tidy, punctual, and the finish is absolutely spot on. They moved furniture carefully and hoovered up every day. Brilliant job, fair price. Will be using them again.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Needed wallpaper hung in the lounge and two feature walls painted. I was worried about the pattern matching but they got it perfect. Professional, friendly, and they didn't leave a mess. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: Rachel M.

reviews.text: Exterior of our rental was looking tired. Elite came out, quoted quickly, and did a really thorough job — cleaned the gutters, prepped everything properly, and the finish looks fresh and clean. Tenants are pleased. Thanks, lads.
reviews.author: Simon T.

address_sub: Serving Quinton, Harborne, Edgbaston, and across Birmingham
emergency_banner_text: Need a quick refresh or emergency redecoration? Get your free quote and site survey today. Ring us —
footer_description: Elite Decorating is a Birmingham-based painter and decorator with 15 years' experience. We deliver quality interior and exterior finishes across Quinton, Harborne, and beyond.
